research.notes: Could not confirm this is the entity in OUSD's MOU: no OUSD or Oakland mention on lapu.edu/apuglobal.edu partnership pages or apu.edu/mou, no registry lookup (EIN, CA SOS) done, and the legal name relationship between Los Angeles Pacific University and APU Global is not stated on cited pages. Needs human review.

profile.summary: A fully online Christ-centered university that offers associate, bachelor's and master's degrees, mainly to working adults. It was formerly called Los Angeles Pacific University and now operates as APU Global (Azusa Pacific University Global).
